note: Execution contract only. No Adam call has been made under this contract. criteria is the single machine-readable source of gates; criteria_sha256 is SHA-256 over its canonical JSON and must be recomputable.

proposals.fault_position: after the Adam proposal is computed and before any parameter commit; the call and its cost are retained
proposals.normal_policy: finite rejection is allowed; no forced parameter movement

objective.episode_order: fixed index list [0, 1, 2, 3] for the four normal proposals; the two faults reuse the last normal episode without an additional exposure
objective.coverage_rule: 12 train episodes cover three audit.position values x the four visible/absent/reverse cells; colour pairs (0,1),(2,3),(4,5) are registered from the request colour word; the coverage set is for class statistics and duty checks, NOT the per-proposal batch
objective.rejected_alternative: full 12-episode batch per objective evaluation; measured extrapolation 6 x 9 x 12 x 0.5469 = 354.4 CPU exceeds the 130 CPU cap and is therefore not admitted
objective.update_target: J_first = first_ce + J_content, matching the calibrated first-question scope
objective.content_term: J_content = -w_y * logsumexp_b(log(omega_b) + log_softmax(W_c h_b + b_c)_y); h_b is the branch_context returned by output(), omega_b = softmax(state['logw']) detached as state, W_c/b_c are the Linear(8,4) head
objective.class_definition: classes are the hex-sorted distinct first-answer byte strings over the full 180 train episodes; w_y = N/(K*count[y])

gradient_duty.check: per-parameter allclose((g1+g2)/2, g_joint, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7) AND max_abs_difference <= 1e-6 AND identical None pattern per parameter; record every None pattern, direction cosine and scale. Rationale: float32 eps=1.19e-7; two independent backward passes over 214 tensors differ by O(eps*||g||). v1 measured max_abs_difference=7.45e-9, far below 1e-6.

update_rule.direction_rule: keep descending proposal; otherwise d' = -||d|| g / ||g|| (float64 reduction)
update_rule.on_reject: restore parameters, keep finite Adam moments and the learner clock

clocks.u: learner proposal clock, increments on every real Adam call including faults
clocks.v: committed parameter version, increments only on an accepted commit
clocks.rule: u and v are stored separately; 0 <= v <= u must hold

capsule.first_nonempty_moment: immediately after the first real Adam call, save the full capsule and restore it in an independent process before the second call
capsule.restore_points: one before and one after each accepted commit
capsule.comparison: body, head, every moment, next objective value, all gradients, RNG and the next proposal must match

criteria.headless: body-only inference distribution and greedy generation must be unchanged by adding the content head; training label indices stay inside the learner

budget.basis: 6 proposals x 9 objective evaluations x 0.5469 CPU + 3 duty backward passes + 3 independent restore pairs + headless generation + startup (2)

decision_rule.engineering_transfer_verified: all 6 calls occur within cap, duty equality holds, every restore matches, headless equivalence holds, u/v and registry stay consistent; signs the ENGINEERING contract only, not a capability and not a training-dose justification
decision_rule.engineering_failure: any parent/source/registry mismatch, gradient duty inequality, restore mismatch, headless leakage or non-finite state
decision_rule.budget_stop: cpu >= 130 or wall >= 260; keep all incurred cost, no shrink-and-rerun
decision_rule.not_admitted_for_budget: measured price makes the frozen required coverage unpayable before any Adam call
decision_rule.inconclusive: fewer than 6 calls completed without a named failure, or a finite rejection count leaves the commit path unexercised without an explicit record

supersedes.reason: v1 gradient-duty tolerance atol=1e-12 is five orders of magnitude below the float32 machine epsilon 1.19e-7; two independent backward passes over 214 tensors accumulate in a different order, so the equality branch is arithmetically unreachable. Only the tolerance changes; no gate, proposal count, budget, data right or exit changes.
